d: Launched in Bahrain in November 2019, Calo is on a mission to make healthy easy. We provide better, faster, and more accessible ways to enjoy nutritious food through technology-driven kitchens. CALO operates high-performance cloud kitchens focused on consistency, speed, and quality, delivering healthy meals at scale.

We are looking for a Chef De Partie – Bakery to join our team, working alongside the Head Chef to manage the bakery section. This includes preparing baked goods, ensuring consistent quality and presentation, maintaining inventory, and supervising junior bakery staff. For this role, we are seeking candidates with a strong bakery background and creativity in pastry, breads, and desserts. The successful candidate will use their culinary and managerial skills to play a key role in elevating our bakery offerings and maintaining exceptional standards.
q: Previous experience as a CDP in a bakery environment.
Minimum of 5 years’ experience within the hospitality sector, preferably in bakery, pastry, or dessert production.
Culinary degree or equivalent experience in a hotel, restaurant, or bakery setting.
Must be currently present in KSA.
Exceptional bakery and kitchen management skills.
Ability to assign responsibilities and monitor progress effectively.
Up-to-date with bakery trends, techniques, and optimized kitchen processes.
Pleasant personality with the ability to lead with empathy and patience.
Customer service mindset, passionate about quality and innovation in bakery products.
r: Ensure that the bakery section operates efficiently while maintaining Calo's quality standards.
Lead the bakery team in a timely and organized manner.
Fill in for the Head Baker or Section Lead when required.
Resourcefully resolve any bakery-related issues and maintain workflow continuity.
Manage and train bakery staff, create work schedules, and assess performance.
Clearly communicate tasks and expectations to team members.
Order and manage bakery inventory appropriately.
Comply with and enforce sanitation regulations and safety standards.
Maintain a positive and professional approach with co-workers.
Produce high-quality baked goods, ensuring consistency in taste, texture, and presentation.

d: GMG is a global well-being company retailing, distributing and manufacturing a portfolio of leading international and home-grown brands across sport, everyday goods, health and beauty, properties and logistics sectors. Under the ownership and management of the Baker family for over 45 years, GMG is a valued partner of choice for the world's most successful and respected brands in the well-being sector. Working across the Middle East, North Africa, and Asia, GMG has introduced more than 120 brands across 12 countries. These include notable home-grown brands such as Sun & Sand Sports, Dropkick, Supercare Pharmacy, Farm Fresh, Klassic, and international brands like Nike, Columbia, Converse, Timberland, Vans, Mama Sita's, and McCain.

The role holder is responsible for managing and driving sales for the store through efficient store operations, visual merchandising, customer service delivery, motivation and retention of store personnel in adherence to GMG norms. The job holder is also responsible for managing and coaching the store team.
q: 5-7 years of relevant experience, with at least 3 years in a similar supervisory role in retail operations
Fluent English, written and spoken; Russian and/or Arabic is an added advantage
Proficiency in MS Office and tools
Strong commercial and analytical skills, with the ability to influence and align teams to business goals
r: Communicate store targets to the team and drive sales to achieve financial objectives
Maintain loss prevention standards and ensure compliance with cash handling, fraud and theft controls
Oversee all point-of-sale activity: transactions, customer orders and payments, returns and refunds, inventory updates and customer feedback
Manage cash transactions, including petty cash, POS cash and change floats
Audit store administration regularly, resolve issues, and support annual stock counts and spot checks
Handle customer complaints and feedback promptly and professionally, taking corrective action in line with policy
Track brand sales performance, research market trends and competitor activity, and propose action plans to grow sales and profitability
Analyze sales reports to maximize stock potential and report on new and core collection performance
Maintain window and in-store displays to a high standard in line with merchandising guidelines
Oversee inventory management: stock availability, ordering, back-store management, stock movement, stock ageing, stock loss and space management
Coordinate with the facilities team on repairs and replacements and support maintenance standards to extend asset life
Plan staffing levels, schedules and shift coverage, factoring in seasonal peaks and promotional events
Train the team in inventory techniques, including receiving, stocking, restocking, transfers and resolving discrepancies
Set clear objectives and performance targets with team members, aligned to organizational goals
Mentor, guide and coach the team to build skills, operational efficiency and continuous improvement
Apply structured performance management to monitor progress, troubleshoot issues and deliver periodic KPIs
Give regular feedback and build a results-oriented environment that supports individual and team growth
Develop leadership pipelines and succession plans within the team
Take ownership and accountability for personal and team outcomes, making timely, sound decisions
Lead the team through change with agility, resilience and a problem-solving mindset
Collaborate with the Area Manager, Brand/Category Management, Warehousing and Logistics, Visual Merchandising and Marketing teams
